host.title: Tenant Host URL
host.description: Full tenant vanity URL, e.g. https://acme.prd.mykronos.com (no trailing path).

#client_id.title: Client ID
#client_id.description: OAuth client id minted by UKG at tenant provisioning.

#client_secret.title: Client Secret
#client_secret.description: OAuth client secret minted by UKG at tenant provisioning.

#username.title: Service Account Username
#username.description: Username of the dedicated WFM service account (password grant).

#password.title: Service Account Password
#password.description: Password of the dedicated WFM service account.
